instruction: Enable the weekday display in the GNOME top bar clock so it shows the day of the week along with the time.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling weekday display in clock. Evaluator checks gsettings org.gnome.desktop.interface clock-show-weekday equals 'true'.
